card.title: We Know the Old Rules
card.instruction: Use an old custom you learned together as the deepest proof of connection, even when the present situation has changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before dinner, we still split the first bread roll. Like when we shared a room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can afford two rolls now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll each have half of two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but you can't buy the sharing separately.

mechanism: A preserves the learned bread-sharing act despite being able to afford separate rolls, treating the division itself as the connection.
confusable: Unlike arbitrary ritual expansion, A protects one old shared custom and explains why its relational value survives changed material circumstances.
comparison: The bread alternative separates mathematical quantity from sharing; the knock alternative separates practical identification from hearing the old friendship signal.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
